- Co-authored “Matrix Multiply Performance of GPUs on Exascale-class HPE/Cray Systems"

positions.title: Scientific Computing Intern
positions.description:
- Performed experiments to test dense linear algebra hardware features of modern GPU processors such as AMD MI25 accelerators and the tensor cores on NVIDIA Turing GPUs with C++17
- Wrote GEMM benchmarking algorithms using CUDA, HIP, ROCm, cuBLAS, hipBLAS, and rocBLAS
- Automated data processing with Google Apps Script and Bash
